items.headline: Luke Drzewiecki's last-second FG lifts Minnesota past No. 15 Iowa
items.description: Minnesota hit a 46-yard FG as time expired to beat No. 15 Iowa 13-10 Saturday to claim the Floyd of Rosedale trophy for the second time in 12 years.

items.headline: Drzewiecki's field goal as time expires lifts Minnesota past No. 15 Iowa, 13-10
items.description: — Luke Drzewiecki kicked a 46-yard field goal as time expired, and Minnesota beat No. 15 Iowa 13-10 Saturday to claim the Floyd of Rosedale trophy for the first time since 2023 and second time in 12 years.

items.headline: Iowa to start QB Jeremy Hecklinski vs. Minnesota, Kirk Ferentz says
items.description: Quarterback Jeremy Hecklinski will start his second straight game for Iowa on Saturday when the No. 15 Hawkeyes visit Minnesota, coach Kirk Ferentz announced Tuesday.
